Definition
[Covariant derivative of a covector field]

Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0294 1. Section A.2\group first-order-differential-operators-on-tensors

The Levi-Civita connection induces a covariant derivative $ abla ^*$ on covector fields, characterized by \[ X igl( heta (Y) igr) = ( abla _X^* heta )(Y) + heta ( abla _X Y) \] for all vector fields $X,Y$ and covector fields $ heta $.
